title: QDiff: Differential Testing of Quantum Software Stacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.08220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Over the past few years, several quantum software stacks (QSS) have been developed in response to rapid hardware advances in quantum computing. A QSS includes a quantum programming language, an optimizing compiler that translates a quantum algorithm written in a high-level language into quantum gate instructions, a quantum simulator that emulates these instructions on a classical device, and a software controller that sends analog signals to a very expensive quantum hardware based on quantum circuits. translated_title: QDiff：量子软件栈的差分测试
translated_abstract: 在过去几年中，为应对量子计算硬件的快速发展，出现了多种量子软件栈。一个量子软件栈包括一种量子编程语言、一个将用高级语言编写的量子算法翻译成量子门指令的优化编译器、一个在经典设备上模拟这些指令的量子模拟器，以及一个基于量子电路向极其昂贵的量子硬件发送模拟信号的软件控制器。与传统的编译器和体系结构模拟器相比，由于测试结果的概率性质、缺乏明确的硬件规范以及量子编程的复杂性，量子软件栈难以进行测试。本工作设计了一种新颖的量子软件栈差分测试方法，命名为QDIFF，具有三项主要创新：（1）我们通过保语义的源到源转换生成待测试的输入程序，以探索（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本论文提出了QDiff，一种针对量子软件栈的新型差分测试方法，通过保语义的源到源转换生成测试输入程序，以检测不同量子软件栈之间的错误与不一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QDiff, a novel differential testing approach for quantum software stacks that generates test input programs via semantics-preserving source-to-source transformations to detect bugs and inconsistencies across different QSSes.
